quests.title: Wake an Age Warden
quests.text: Each Age keeps a Warden. Raise an Ascendant altar and follow the clues of its rite.

quests.title: Warden of Age I: step 1
quests.text: The first hearth was ringed with flint. Sixteen chips, laid at the foot of the stone.

quests.title: Warden of Age I: step 2
quests.text: The walking dead guard the old fire-ring. Let six fall in sight of the altar.

quests.title: Warden of Age I: step 3
quests.text: Trees stand in the stone's mind. Seal them in this order, no other: the gate the Fair Folk keep; then kin of the tree that holds up the world.

quests.title: Warden of Age I: step 4
quests.text: The stone will answer only in the breath between night and the first light. Use the altar then.

quests.title: Warden of Age I: step 5
quests.text: Whatever you woke will come to see who woke it. Hold the altar for 30 breaths of the sun-count and do not leave it.

quests.title: Warden of Age II: step 1
quests.text: The green metal came before the bright one. Sixteen ingots, warm from the pot.

quests.title: Warden of Age II: step 2
quests.text: Bone-archers keep the ore roads. Ten must be unstrung.

quests.title: Warden of Age II: step 3
quests.text: Trees stand in the stone's mind. Seal them in this order, no other: the gate the Fair Folk keep; then the pale one that wears the first white.

quests.title: Warden of Age II: step 4
quests.text: The stone will answer only as the sun drowns and the first stars wake. Use the altar then.

quests.title: Warden of Age II: step 5
quests.text: Whatever you woke will come to see who woke it. Hold the altar for 40 breaths of the sun-count and do not leave it.

quests.title: Warden of Age III: step 1
quests.text: The altar eats before it fights. Set one feast upon the stone, a dish worth a guest-gift.

quests.title: Warden of Age III: step 2
quests.text: Two soft metals made one hard. Eight bronze bars upon the stone.

quests.title: Warden of Age III: step 3
quests.text: The weavers of the dark hollows resent the smiths. Twelve of them fewer.

quests.title: Warden of Age III: step 4
quests.text: Trees stand in the stone's mind. Seal them in this order, no other: red berries set against the witch; then the gate the Fair Folk keep; then red berries set against the witch.

quests.title: Warden of Age III: step 5
quests.text: The stone will answer only when no shadow falls beside the stone. Use the altar then.

quests.title: Warden of Age III: step 6
quests.text: Whatever you woke will come to see who woke it. Hold the altar for 45 breaths of the sun-count and do not leave it.

quests.title: Warden of Age IV: step 1
quests.text: The altar eats before it fights. Set one feast upon the stone, a dish worth a guest-gift.

quests.title: Warden of Age IV: step 2
quests.text: The grey metal rings truer than the bronze. Twenty-four ingots, cold and plain.

quests.title: Warden of Age IV: step 3
quests.text: The brewers who sold the smiths their ruin. Five must answer.

quests.title: Warden of Age IV: step 4
quests.text: Trees stand in the stone's mind. Seal them in this order, no other: kin of the tree that holds up the world; then the pale one that wears the first white; then the weeper by the water.

quests.title: Warden of Age IV: step 5
quests.text: The stone will answer only when the moon stands highest over the stone. Use the altar then.

quests.title: Warden of Age IV: step 6
quests.text: Whatever you woke will come to see who woke it. Hold the altar for 60 breaths of the sun-count and do not leave it.

quests.title: Warden of Age V: step 1
quests.text: The altar eats before it fights. Set one feast upon the stone, a dish worth a guest-gift.

quests.title: Warden of Age V: step 2
quests.text: Iron taught to bend and not break. Eight steel bars for the warden's gate.

quests.title: Warden of Age V: step 3
quests.text: The hissing ones undo what smiths make. Fifteen must be put out.

quests.title: Warden of Age V: step 4
quests.text: Trees stand in the stone's mind. Seal them in this order, no other: the nut of the one who knows; then the weeper by the water; then kin of the tree that holds up the world; then the gate the Fair Folk keep.

quests.title: Warden of Age V: step 5
quests.text: The stone will answer only in the breath between night and the first light. Use the altar then.

quests.title: Warden of Age V: step 6
quests.text: It will not wake for one hand. 2 must stand at the altar together, or the stone will take a token for every spirit that stands in for a friend.

quests.title: Warden of Age V: step 7
quests.text: Whatever you woke will come to see who woke it. Hold the altar for 75 breaths of the sun-count and do not leave it.

quests.title: Warden of Age VI: step 1
quests.text: The altar eats before it fights. Set one feast upon the stone, a dish worth a guest-gift.

quests.title: Warden of Age VI: step 2
quests.text: The late age runs on red dust and wire. Eight blocks, packed and dull.

quests.title: Warden of Age VI: step 3
quests.text: Tall walkers step between the wires. Eight must lose their footing.

quests.title: Warden of Age VI: step 4
quests.text: Trees stand in the stone's mind. Seal them in this order, no other: the winter king, green when all is grey; then red berries set against the witch; then the one that bleeds when it is cut; then the door-wood, the strong one.

quests.title: Warden of Age VI: step 5
quests.text: The stone will answer only when no shadow falls beside the stone. Use the altar then.

quests.title: Warden of Age VI: step 6
quests.text: It will not wake for one hand. 2 must stand at the altar together, or the stone will take a token for every spirit that stands in for a friend.

quests.title: Warden of Age VI: step 7
quests.text: Whatever you woke will come to see who woke it. Hold the altar for 90 breaths of the sun-count and do not leave it.

quests.title: Warden of Age Rodos: step 1
quests.text: The altar eats before it fights. Set one feast upon the stone, a dish worth a guest-gift.

quests.title: Warden of Age Rodos: step 2
quests.text: The last Age answers in echoes. Six shards, still ringing.

quests.title: Warden of Age Rodos: step 3
quests.text: Sleepless watchers circle the end of days. Twelve must fall.

quests.title: Warden of Age Rodos: step 4
quests.text: Trees stand in the stone's mind. Seal them in this order, no other: the weeper by the water; then the nut of the one who knows; then kin of the tree that holds up the world; then the nut of the one who knows; then the gate the Fair Folk keep.

quests.title: Warden of Age Rodos: step 5
quests.text: The stone will answer only when the moon stands highest over the stone. Use the altar then.

quests.title: Warden of Age Rodos: step 6
quests.text: It will not wake for one hand. 3 must stand at the altar together, or the stone will take a token for every spirit that stands in for a friend.

quests.title: Warden of Age Rodos: step 7
quests.text: Whatever you woke will come to see who woke it. Hold the altar for 105 breaths of the sun-count and do not leave it.
